method.clicks: Page clicks the user makes for the task: focusing a field, pressing a button, switching a mode. Paste keystrokes and keyboard Tab presses are not clicks. The earlier batch-C artefact (a second click counted for a paste into an already-focused field) is removed: the field is focused once.
method.scroll: window.scrollY when the result was read. A result below the fold is recorded as 'needs scroll' even when scrollY is 0.
method.keyboard: From a fresh load, Tab from the top until the main control is focused; then type/paste and Tab or Enter to trigger. Native file dialogs are outside the record and counted as chooser opened from the keyboard.
method.paste: ego-browser keyboard.paste() left fields empty in this environment; a real paste was performed by writing the text to the browser clipboard (navigator.clipboard.writeText) and sending Cmd+V, then checking the field value. This is a genuine browser paste.
